snippet.title: NIKKE | Resident Evil Collab Announcement | Into The Infinite 2025
snippet.description:
The worlds of NIKKE and Resident Evil collide in a spine-chilling crossover.

Play as Resident Evil’s iconic characters in GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE. Face evil bosses, unlock exclusive content, and survive the infection.

Stay tuned for the collaboration.

Developed by Shift Up and published by Level Infinite.

#IntotheInfinite #gamescom2025 #NIKKE #ResidentEvil
